cousin of CMY

Daughter of Sir John Taylor Coleridge and sister of Mary Coleridge, she married (7 Aug 1845) the Rt.

Rev.

John Fielder Mackarness (1820-1889); she was very ill in November 1851. [Story of a Devonshire House; PB 1914 Coleridge; Coleridge, Life of Keble 361]
